study: Preliminary implementation progress study, not the final evaluation
scoreWeights: Unmodified SCORE_WEIGHTS in src/core/selection.js; see SHA-256 snapshot
candidatePolicy: One shared per-update pool including union-retained IDs across all seven variants
reference: Same-shader full-density image; not geometric ground truth

environment.backend: Headless Chrome / ANGLE SwiftShader software rasterization

limitations: One orbit, one budget, one seed; no statistical or cross-dataset generalization claim.
Fixture is synthetic; Jetliner is an uncolored mesh-derived sample, not a raw scan.
Jetliner has zero color saliency, so Geometry and Full have identical scores.
Readback synchronizes rendering; CPU timings are diagnostic wall time and do not establish native GPU performance.
Temporal metric uses nearest-neighbor reference reprojection and absolute raw-depth tolerance 0.0001.
All image samples and all seven variants are retained without selecting favorable frames.
